learning_outcomes.text: Select, write a technical report, and economically value the electrical machines necessary for a specific industrial installation.
Perform, analyze, and write a technical report on the most common tests carried out on the electrical machines studied in the course.
Derive and apply the equivalent circuit of the electrical machines studied in the course.
Calculate and analyze parameters and characteristics of the operation of the electrical machines studied in the course.
Calculate, design, and write technical reports for the electrical machines studied in the course.

syllabus_topics: Calculation and design of electrical machines
Control of electrical machines and drives and their applications
Testing and operation of induction machines
Testing and operation of synchronous machines
assessment_rules: For ordinary assessment, a minimum grade of 2.5 out of 10 is required for Block I (Motors) and Block II (Generators and transformers). If these minimums are met and the final course grade is 5.0 or higher, the final grade is calculated as (0.15 x PL) + 0.85 x (0.6 x B1 + 0.4 x B2). Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated formula result and 4.0. For extraordinary assessment, a single theoretical exam covering all course content is administered.
